assets.name: 低矮草丛
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one reusable transparent PNG botanical sprite for a fixed-view website footer meadow.
Reference image: the attached panorama is a STYLE REFERENCE only. Match its hand-painted gouache / painterly 3D-to-2D appearance: visible angular brushwork, sculpted color planes, subdued sage/olive leaves, deep blue-green shadows, warm cream highlights, soft natural light from upper left. Keep the color and brush texture consistent with this reference. Create a NEW independent plant, not the whole scene.
Framing: single plant or connected small clump, centered, upright, all tips and base visible, at least 10% clear transparent margin on all four sides. Front / slight three-quarter view with NO ground plane, rooted at bottom center. Readable silhouette at 100–240px tall.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the plant, including spaces between leaves and stems. Opaque rich painted colors within the foliage. No white matte, no checkerboard painted into the image.
Constraints: no butterflies, insects, pot, soil, detached objects, cast shadow, lettering, border, watermark, UI, or background scenery. No photographic texture, no flat vector clip art. Output one image around 1024px with genuine alpha.
Subject: A low and wide, irregular fan-shaped tuft of soft meadow grass, about 12–16 narrow curved tapering blades joined at a compact low base. Shorter blades at the sides, several longer arching blades in the middle, with varied directions and open gaps. Width roughly 1.5 times height. Mostly muted sage and moss green with a few warm olive planes; only occasional deeper teal shadows. No seed heads and no flowers. Keep the bottom foliage loose and organic rather than a solid mound.
